notes: NEW MAP: BLACKWELL HOSPITAL - a huge two-storey hospital, almost all indoors. Long corridors, wards, the ER, surgery, x-ray, the morgue, labs and a bridge across the atrium. Plays in every multiplayer mode and in Zombies.
ZOMBIES ONLINE CO-OP: in the Zombies lobby set PLAY to ONLINE CO-OP, then FIND A CO-OP GAME, or type a private code to play with friends. Up to 4 survivors.
In co-op the host presses START. Everyone keeps their own points and guns; the round is shared.

Going down in co-op: a teammate holds USE next to you for 3 seconds to revive you (they get 50 points). If you bleed out after 30 seconds you come back at the start of the next round with a pistol. Everyone down = game over.
If the co-op host leaves, another player takes over and the game keeps going.
